notes.title: Secret Mission 1 Graphical and Performance update
notes.notes:
[b]Weather[/b]
Added snow fall and changed cloud movement direction to match.

[b]Post Processing[/b]
Reworked the vibrancy and glow effects and removed excess post processing features that were costing performance with little or no visible change when removed. 

[b]Enemies[/b]
Changed some positioning and timing of mission so that the mission is well passed and constant challenge.

[b]Boss[/b]
  Removed bad colliders and reworked the collider system on the boss to get better performance during the boss fight.  
  Increased the amount of damage boss can take by about 50% to all of it's parts except the energy shields. 
  Increased the boss's core life by a lot it had been lower for testing but now it is where it should be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42096696/c43fa010280a2fb175d2dbc5e6299abb8cb390b6.png[/img]


As always please enjoy

Jared

notes.title: Patch_10252023 Performance optimization
notes.notes:
[h1]Game performance and manger updates[/h1]

[b]Buildings and structures[/b]
Updated the manager so that when these objects are no longer needed they get destroyed.

[b]Enemy updates[/b]
Went through all the enemies, and removed extra scripts, and modified particle systems for better performance.

Added an enemy management system that handles which enemies are active through out the level and refined the destroy system to make sure once they are no longer needed they get destroyed properly.

notes.title: Mission 6 Release
notes.notes:
[b]Mission 6 Release[/b]
  Another tough level that has two rescue unlocks, Ship #5 and the Bomb technology researcher

[b]Performance Update[/b]
  Built and added a resource processing system that greatly improves the games performance in frames per second. 

[b]Graphical Updates[/b]
  Added new weather and lighting to the missions, to greatly improve the look and feel of the game.

[b]Ambience audio added[/b]
  Weather condition audio added to the missions, ambience audio level can be adjusted in settings. 

Hope you enjoy this amazing update

Jared

notes.title: Secret Mission 1 Version 2 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Updates[/b]
[b]Secret Mission 1 Boss improvements.[/b]
  Removed excess colliders with boss better performance and less processing required.
  Increased Boss movement speed better difficulty.
  Changed Boss movement path so that it is more on the screen and more engaging.
  Updated the amount of damage boss can take both in shields and parts.

Fixed some structures in the mission player colliding with buildings, was not a good.

Play testing is always the best bug finder... : )

Again enjoy as always

Jared.

notes.title: Secret Mission 1 Build
notes.notes:
[b]Secret Mission 1[/b] is now added to the game, this can be unlocked by beating [u]Mission 5 while destroying all enemies[/u]. 

[b]-- Improvements and fixes[/b]
Changed the graphics of some of the projectiles so they are more vivid. 

Fixed a bug where player would collide into something and it would destroy your ability to fire anymore.
Enemy model collider types refined for better performance.
Both player and enemy code tweaks to remove excess processing per frame. 

As always please enjoy,   Jared.

notes.title: Patch 04-25-2023
notes.notes:
Fixed 2nd player user interface navigation glitches.

Fixed in game point display at the top of screen during missions so it doesn't look choppy anymore.

Removed excess colliders from structures and other mission objects that didn't need them to improve frame rate. 

And other small tweaks as I reviewed through my source code, finding and fixing behaviors that would increase processing time. 

Currently working on Secret Mission 1 and Mission 6 and plan to have them out soon, as a one man team I had taken a break for a while but I am back to it and pushing forward with development. 

Please enjoy..

notes.title: Another Performance improvement
notes.notes:
Fixed colliders on the turrets.
Fixed the smoke when some drones and tanks explode so the duration of the smoke is reduced.
Added the platforms below the turrets to make them more visible and add to the visuals of the game by added more color.

notes.title: Performance Improvements patch
notes.notes:
Mission 2, 3, 4 fixed Level of detail(LOD) distances for trees so that they will stay the same instead of changing to lower or higher models based on camera distance.  Was causing an obvious glitch where trees would change as you get closer to them.

  Fixed heat seeking missiles colliders fixed so they are tight fit to the missile previous versions had a bigger hit box than the actual missile. 

  Fixed colliders on rescue ships so that they are less complex improving physics performance when they explode everywhere. 

  As always Enjoy and thanks for playing my game. 

Jared.

notes.title: Reduced the difficulty for missions
notes.notes:
I lowered the amount of life that the turrets have this should help people get past mission 2 and 3.

I had attempted to beat mission 2 with a new game for about 30 attempts and I narrowed down the problem to the amount of life the turrets have. 

Hope this helps people that were stuck on mission 2

Jared..
